Tervotek Global Solutions

Client website · Live at tervotek.com

  • Website design
  • Web development
  • Responsive layouts
  • Interactive experience

The brief

Tervotek connects specialist sourcing, business technology and coordinated project delivery. Its website needed to explain that breadth while giving visitors a direct route to the solution or sector relevant to them.

A clear structure for a broad offer

The site separates solutions, industries, company information and insights. Six solution categories cover healthcare, education, digital technology, engineering, procurement and implementation, with dedicated pages that make the offer easier to explore.

A distinctive first impression

A dark visual system pairs large editorial typography with a silver globe and restrained red accents. The globe introduces the company’s global outlook, while interactive process steps explain how a requirement moves through discovery, sourcing, validation, delivery and support.

From exploration to a conversation

Solution and industry pages connect the detail back to a clear contact path. Responsive navigation, direct enquiry links and a consistent page system carry the experience from the homepage into the rest of the website.

The delivered website

A live corporate website designed and developed by VisionCraft Labs, bringing Tervotek’s capabilities, approach and contact information together under one identity.
